label: placesAsLayer: a dropped image to place is taken as one to open, so no layer is added
find: if case .place(let path) = action { path } else { nil }
replace: if case .open(let path) = action { path } else { nil }

label: importsOnce: the old saved list is kept, so a second launch imports it again
oneStep: each placed image is its own Place step, so one Undo leaves part of the drop
openInNeedsAnImage: Open In hands a path on with no image open
find: guard canvas != nil, let path = fileFlow.documentPath else { return nil }
replace: guard let path = fileFlow.documentPath else { return nil }

label: openInIsPhotos: the open image's ref names another app, so Open In and the import file it under the wrong app
